title: The Quiet Static
author: Isandro Blackwood
blurb: Ulyana Ravensworth, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
